# Erdos.p535 — Erdős problem 535

Reference: https://www.erdosproblems.com/535
Imported from google-deepmind/formal-conjectures (`ErdosProblems/535.lean`, theorem `erdos_535`, AMS 5 11).

Let $r \geq 3$, and let $f_r(N)$ denote the size of the largest subset of $\{1,\ldots,N\}$
such that no subset of size $r$ has the same pairwise greatest common divisor between all
elements. Erdős [Er64] proved that $f_3(N) > N^{c/\log\log N}$ for some constant $c > 0$, and
conjectured this should also be an upper bound; here we state the conjectural upper bound
for all $r \geq 3$.

See also [536].

## Statement
∀ r ≥ 3, ∃ c > (0 : ℝ),
    ∀ᶠ (N : ℕ) in atTop,
      (f r N : ℝ) ≤ (N : ℝ) ^ (c / log (log (N : ℝ)))

## Strategic notes
Open conjecture — prove-or-refute posture applies to sub-claims,
but the root asserts the conjectured statement itself. No
per-problem hints (benchmark integrity).
